title: Epic: OrcaSlicer Profile Selection Flow Redesign
description:
## Overview
The slicer panel profile selection flow is fundamentally broken. The current implementation uses printer instances instead of printer models, hardcodes filament profiles, and shows worker versions instead of slicer types.

## Required Flow (OrcaSlicer-style)
1. **Printer Model** → User selects from catalog (/api/catalog/printer-models)
2. **Machine Profiles** → Populated based on selected printer model (with nozzle variants)
3. **Filament Profiles** → Filtered by selected machine profile (from API, not hardcoded)
4. **Process Profiles** → Filtered by selected machine profile (from API)
5. **Slicer Selection** → Shows slicer types/versions (OrcaSlicer, PrusaSlicer), not worker info

## Current Problems
| Component | Current | Required |
|-----------|---------|----------|
| Printer Selection | selectedPrinterId (instances) | Printer Model from catalog |
| Machine Profiles | Not shown, flat list | Dropdown filtered by printer model |
| Filament Profiles | Hardcoded MATERIAL_PRESETS | API-driven, filtered by machine |
| Process Profiles | Returns ALL profiles | Filtered by machine profile |
| Slicer Selection | Worker versions | Slicer types/versions |

## API Support Available
- /api/catalog/printer-models - printer models with specs
- /api/slicer/profiles/hierarchy?machineProfileId=X - filtered profiles
- byHierarchy[manufacturer].models[model] structure exists

## Files to Modify
- src/Web/ReactApp/src/features/slicer/pages/NewSliceJobPage.tsx
- src/Web/ReactApp/src/services/slicerProfilesService.ts
- Possibly: src/Web/ReactApp/src/features/slicer/components/ProfileSelector.tsx

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Profile selection cascades: Model → Machine → Filament/Process
- [ ] No hardcoded material presets
- [ ] Slicer dropdown shows types, not worker info
- [ ] All profiles come from API
- [ ] UI matches OrcaSlicer-style workflow

title: Add Printer Model Selector to NewSliceJobPage
description:
## Summary
Replace the current printer instance selector with a printer model selector that fetches from the catalog API.

## Current State
- Uses `selectedPrinterId` which selects printer instances (physical printers)
- Gets printers from `apiClient.getPrinters()`

## Required Changes
1. Add new state: `selectedPrinterModelId`
2. Fetch printer models from `/api/catalog/printer-models`
3. Create a dropdown showing manufacturer + model name
4. Store selected model's specs (maxX/Y/Z, manufacturer) for later use
5. Keep printer instance selector optional (for sending to specific printer)

## Files to Modify
- `src/Web/ReactApp/src/features/slicer/pages/NewSliceJobPage.tsx`

## API Reference
```
GET /api/catalog/printer-models
Returns: { id, name, manufacturerId, manufacturerName, maxX, maxY, maxZ, motionType, toolheads[], supportedFilamentTypes[] }
```

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Printer Model dropdown fetches from catalog API
- [ ] Shows Manufacturer + Model Name format
- [ ] Stores model specs for bed dimensions
- [ ] Triggers machine profile filtering when changed

title: Add Machine Profile Dropdown filtered by Printer Model
description:
## Summary
Add a Machine Profile dropdown that filters available machine profiles based on the selected printer model.

## Current State
- Machine profiles exist in `processProfilesData?.machineProfiles` but are not displayed
- No filtering by printer model

## Required Changes
1. Add state: `selectedMachineProfileId`
2. When printer model changes, filter machine profiles by manufacturer name
3. Machine profiles include nozzle variants (e.g., 'Prusa MK3.5 0.4 nozzle', 'Prusa MK3.5 0.6 nozzle')
4. Display dropdown with available machine profiles for selected model
5. Auto-select first matching profile or remember last selection

## Profile Structure Reference
```typescript
machineProfiles: {
  'Prusa': [
    { id: '...', name: 'Prusa MK3.5 0.4 nozzle', manufacturer: 'Prusa' },
    { id: '...', name: 'Prusa MINI 0.4 nozzle', manufacturer: 'Prusa' }
  ],
  'Voron': [...]
}
```

## Files to Modify
- `src/Web/ReactApp/src/features/slicer/pages/NewSliceJobPage.tsx`

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Machine Profile dropdown appears after printer model selected
- [ ] Shows only profiles matching selected manufacturer
- [ ] Includes nozzle size variants
- [ ] Selection triggers filament/process profile filtering

title: Replace Hardcoded Filament Presets with API-driven Profiles
description:
## Summary
Remove the hardcoded MATERIAL_PRESETS constant and fetch filament profiles from the API, filtered by selected machine profile.

## Current State
```typescript
const MATERIAL_PRESETS: Record<MaterialType, MaterialPreset> = {
  'PLA': { name: 'PLA', nozzleTemp: 210, bedTemp: 60 },
  'PETG': { name: 'PETG', nozzleTemp: 240, bedTemp: 80 },
  'ABS': { name: 'ABS', nozzleTemp: 245, bedTemp: 100 },
  // ... hardcoded
};

const filamentProfiles = useMemo(() => {
  return MATERIAL_PRESETS;  // ❌ WRONG - hardcoded
}, []);
```

## Required Changes
1. Remove `MATERIAL_PRESETS` constant
2. Update state from `selectedFilamentMaterial: MaterialType` to `selectedFilamentProfileId: string`
3. Fetch filament profiles from `/api/slicer/profiles/hierarchy` API
4. Filter by `compatiblePrinters` matching selected machine profile
5. Display with material type grouping (PLA, PETG, ABS, etc.)
6. Extract nozzleTemp/bedTemp from selected profile

## API Response Structure
```typescript
filamentProfiles['All']: [
  { id: '...', name: 'Generic PLA @System', material: 'PLA', nozzleTemperature: 210, bedTemperature: 60 },
  { id: '...', name: 'Bambu PLA Basic @System', material: 'PLA', ... },
  // 80+ profiles
]
```

## Files to Modify
- `src/Web/ReactApp/src/features/slicer/pages/NewSliceJobPage.tsx`

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] MATERIAL_PRESETS constant removed
- [ ] Filament profiles fetched from API
- [ ] Profiles filtered by compatible machines
- [ ] Grouped by material type in dropdown
- [ ] Temps extracted from selected profile

title: Filter Process Profiles by Selected Machine Profile
description:
## Summary
Update process profile filtering to only show profiles compatible with the selected machine profile.

## Current State
```typescript
const printerProcessProfiles = useMemo(() => {
  // Returns all process profiles - no filtering!
  return processProfilesData?.processProfiles ?? [];
}, [processProfilesData]);
```

## Required Changes
1. Filter `processProfiles` by selected machine profile
2. Match using profile name suffix (e.g., '@Voron', '@MK3.5', '@MINI')
3. Use `compatiblePrinters` array if available in profile
4. Group by quality level (Fine, Standard, Draft)

## API Response Structure
```typescript
processProfiles['All']: [
  { id: '...', name: '0.20mm Standard @Voron', quality: 'Standard', layerHeight: 0.2 },
  { id: '...', name: '0.15mm Speed @MK3.5', quality: 'Fine', layerHeight: 0.15 },
  // 60+ profiles
]
```

## Files to Modify
- `src/Web/ReactApp/src/features/slicer/pages/NewSliceJobPage.tsx`

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Process profiles filtered by machine
- [ ] Shows only compatible profiles
- [ ] Grouped by quality level
- [ ] Updates when machine profile changes

title: Fix Slicer Dropdown to Show Types Instead of Worker Versions
description:
## Summary
The slicer dropdown currently shows worker versions instead of slicer types and versions.

## Current State
```typescript
const engineOptions = useMemo(() => {
  return availableSlicers.map(slicer => ({
    label: `${slicer.name || slicer.slicerType || 'Unknown'} v${slicer.version || '?'}`,
    // Shows: 'printfarmer-orcaslicer-worker v2.2.0' ❌ WRONG
    value: slicer.slicerType === 'PrusaSlicer' ? 1 : slicer.slicerType === 'OrcaSlicer' ? 2 : 0
  }));
}, [availableSlicers]);
```

## Required Changes
1. Show slicer type name, not worker name
2. Show slicer engine version, not worker version
3. Format: 'OrcaSlicer 2.2.0' or 'PrusaSlicer 2.8.0'
4. Deduplicate if multiple workers of same type
5. Use slicerType for display, not name

## Expected Result
- 'OrcaSlicer 2.2.0' (not 'printfarmer-orcaslicer-worker v2.2.0')
- 'PrusaSlicer 2.8.0' (not 'printfarmer-prusaslicer-worker v2.8.0')

## Files to Modify
- `src/Web/ReactApp/src/features/slicer/pages/NewSliceJobPage.tsx`

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Shows 'OrcaSlicer' not worker name
- [ ] Shows engine version not worker version
- [ ] Deduplicated slicer types
- [ ] Clean format: 'SlicerType Version'

title: Update Profile Selection Cascading Logic
description:
## Summary
Implement proper cascading logic so profile dropdowns reset/refilter when parent selections change.

## Required Cascade Flow
```
Printer Model → Machine Profiles → Filament Profiles
                                → Process Profiles
```

## Required Changes
1. When Printer Model changes:
   - Reset Machine Profile selection
   - Clear Filament Profile selection
   - Clear Process Profile selection
   
2. When Machine Profile changes:
   - Filter Filament Profiles by compatible machines
   - Filter Process Profiles by machine
   - Keep selections if still valid, otherwise reset

3. Add useEffect hooks for cascade triggers
4. Implement profile validation on change

## Reference Implementation
See `SlicerProfilesPage.tsx` which has correct cascading:
```typescript
const { data: hierarchyProfiles } = useQuery({
  queryKey: ['slicerProfilesHierarchy', selectedMachineProfileId],
  queryFn: () => slicerProfilesService.listHierarchical(selectedMachineProfileId),
});
```

## Files to Modify
- `src/Web/ReactApp/src/features/slicer/pages/NewSliceJobPage.tsx`

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Model change resets machine profile
- [ ] Machine change filters filament/process
- [ ] Invalid selections cleared automatically
- [ ] No stale profile selections

title: Add Unit Tests for Profile Selection Flow
description:
## Summary
Add comprehensive unit tests for the new profile selection flow in NewSliceJobPage.

## Test Cases Required

### 1. Printer Model Selection
- Fetches printer models from catalog API
- Displays manufacturer + model name
- Stores model specs correctly

### 2. Machine Profile Filtering
- Filters by selected manufacturer
- Shows nozzle variants
- Resets on printer model change

### 3. Filament Profile Filtering
- Fetches from API (not hardcoded)
- Filters by compatible machines
- Groups by material type

### 4. Process Profile Filtering
- Filters by machine profile
- Groups by quality level
- Updates on machine change

### 5. Cascading Logic
- Model change clears downstream selections
- Machine change re-filters profiles
- Invalid selections cleared

### 6. Slicer Dropdown
- Shows slicer types not worker names
- Deduplicates entries

## Files to Create/Modify
- `src/Web/ReactApp/src/features/slicer/pages/__tests__/NewSliceJobPage.test.tsx`

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All test cases implemented
- [ ] Tests pass with mocked API responses
- [ ] Coverage for edge cases
- [ ] Tests for loading/error states
